home.subtitleDefault: Search a city, pick stops, optimize the path, and open it in Google Maps.
home.subtitleActive: Continue planning, or clear the itinerary and start fresh.
home.tipSettings: Tip: set start/end addresses in Settings.
home.offlineBanner: Saved routes still open offline. New city searches need internet.
home.offlineSearch: You’re offline. Open a saved route instead — new city searches need internet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Set language, route addresses, search radius, and which place types to include when searching a city.
settings.languageHint: App UI and Google Places / Geocoding results follow this language.
settings.startHelp: Used as the Google Maps origin when generating a route.
settings.endHelp: Used as the Google Maps destination. Leave empty to end at the last attraction.
settings.transportHint: Used when opening the route in Google Maps.
settings.categoriesHint: Default is Tourist only. Select more types to broaden results.
settings.radiusError: Enter a value between {{min}} and {{max}} km.
settings.accountHint: Sign in to save export links. Connect Google Drive only when you export ZIPs.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in with your email to sync photo export links.
auth.registerSubtitle: Use email and password. Google Drive is connected later when you export.
auth.passwordShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.
auth.driveConnectedBody: Travel Go can upload export ZIPs to your Google Drive.
auth.driveNotConfigured: Add EXPO_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_ANDROID_CLIENT_ID to .env (package com.travelgo.app + SHA-1), then rebuild.

exports.hint: ZIP files live in your Google Drive. Travel Go only stores the links.
exports.signInBody: Sign in with email to see your export list. Drive is connected separately when you export.
exports.confirmBody: We’ll zip these photos, upload the ZIP to your Google Drive, and save the link in Travel Go.
exports.successBody: The ZIP is in your Google Drive. You can open it anytime from My photo exports.
exports.missingDriveToken: Google Drive permission is missing. Connect Drive and allow access.
exports.emptyBody: Export a city album from the Photos screen to see it here.
exports.openFailed: Could not open the Drive link.
exports.removeBody: Removed from Travel Go. The ZIP remains in your Google Drive.

map.title: My map
map.tapCity: Choose Attractions or Photos for a city
map.noCities: No cities found for this country.
map.offlineCities: You’re offline. Connect to load top cities for this country.
map.citiesError: Could not load cities for this country.
map.openCityOfflineBody: Connect to the internet to load attractions for this city.
map.openCityErrorBody: Something went wrong while loading attractions.

album.hint: Photos stay in your gallery. Travel Go only keeps links organized by city.
album.emptyBody: Add pictures from your gallery or camera. They’ll be filed under this city.
album.addPhotosHint: Choose where to add photos from.
album.removeBody: The photo stays in your gallery. Only the link in Travel Go is removed.
album.duplicatesAllBody: Those photos are already linked to this city.
album.duplicatesPartialBody: Added {{added}}. Skipped {{skipped}} already in this album.

detail.wikiLoading: Loading the place story from Wikipedia…
detail.wikiMissing: No Wikipedia article found for this place yet.
detail.wikiAttribution: Source: Wikipedia · text available under CC BY-SA.
detail.noDescription: No editorial description is available for this place yet.

trip.title: Live trip
trip.hint: Start tracking. We’ll notify you when you arrive at the next stop (~120 m).
trip.startedBody: We’ll watch the next stop (~120 m radius) and send a notification on arrival.
trip.bgOk: Background location is on — arrivals work even if you switch to Maps.
trip.bgLimited: Background location isn’t fully granted. Foreground tracking still works while the app is open. For arrivals in Maps, use a preview APK and allow “Always”.
trip.stopBody: We’ll stop watching for arrivals. Your route stops stay as they are.

errors.noLocation: No location found for “{{name}}”. Try another city.
